name: iniBuilds A350-900（2024 原生）
notes: 需要安装 iniBuilds A350-900（inibuilds-aircraft-a350）。required_tags=ext_a359 来自真实包 jeffs-livery-ini-a350-900-CAL-B18901 的 [Selection]，缺失会导致涂装不显示。真实包还带 [Panel_DynamicParameters] 与包级 Config/ 目录，新建简单涂装可省略。
livery_cfg_template:
[Version]
major = 1
minor = 0

[General]
name = "{title}"
atc_id = "{atc_id}"
atc_airline = "{atc_airline}"
icao_airline = "{icao_airline}"

[Selection]
required_tags = "{required_tags}"

[Panel_DynamicParameters]
param.0 = "airline,{title}"
